summary: With help, say the counting numbers in order, starting at 1 and going up to 30.
With help, know and name the written numbers 0 to 20, and try writing them.
With help, use objects to compare amounts and tell which is more, less, the same or different.
Know that a written number stands for how many, and match groups of 0 to 10 with their numbers.
Count up to 10 things or actions, touching each once, even when scattered, and say how many.
Use words like more than, less than, equal, same and different to compare things.
With help, try out adding and taking away using hands-on classroom materials.
With help, act out everyday adding and taking-away problems up to 5 with objects.
With help, break a number up to 10 into two parts in more than one way, using objects.
With help, copy simple patterns with objects and say what comes next to keep them going.
Notice what can be measured, like length, weight and size, using words like big, tall, full, heavy.
Compare two objects by length, weight or size, try measuring with things like blocks, and explore rulers.
With help, sort and group objects by things like color, size, length or weight.
With help, name shapes such as circles, squares, triangles, rectangles, cubes and spheres.
Find and name shapes in the world around you, whatever their size or turn, and tell them apart.
With help, explore how flat shapes like squares differ from solid shapes like cubes.
With help, make shapes from things like sticks, play dough, blocks and pipe cleaners.
With help, put shapes together to make pictures of things, like a square and a triangle for a house.
